name: Four Seasons Hotel Hampshire
positioning: Country-estate hotel in a restored 18th-century manor at Dogmersfield Park, Hampshire, with a spa, family pool and equestrian centre
best_for: Travelers wanting a countryside escape in Hampshire
Families who want a pool, kids programme and outdoor activities

facts.text: The address is Dogmersfield Park, Chalky Lane, Dogmersfield, Hampshire RG27 8TD, England.
Dogmersfield Park is first mentioned in the Domesday Book of 1086.
Four Seasons Hotel Hampshire is set within a beautifully restored 18th-century manor.
Wild Carrot serves Modern British cuisine.
The Drawing Room serves afternoon tea.
La Terrazza features a traditional pizza oven.
London Heathrow Airport is 35 minutes by car from the hotel.
Fleet Railway Station is the closest train station to the hotel.

highlights.text: The infinity pool is connected to an outdoor vitality pool with water-massage features.
The Equestrian Centre has two outdoor arenas.
The hotel offers complimentary bicycle hire.
The Basingstoke Canal runs through the hotel's estate.
The spa offers treatments from leading brands such as 111SKIN and Ila.

considerations.text: Gatwick Airport is 90 minutes by car from the hotel.
Chauffeur and car hire services should be arranged at least 24 hours in advance.
Children must be ages 16 or over to use the fitness facilities.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
